topics.topic: OwnerFormField runtime representation, construction responsibility, and source records
questions: Does `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` contain constructed `OwnerFormField` values, raw records from which the owner interface constructs them, or structural records for which no `OwnerFormField` runtime value is created; consequently, who constructs each value and from what?

Who constructs the OwnerFormField values: does the data provider instantiate typed OwnerFormField rows in OWNER_FORM_FIELDS, or does the owner interface convert raw constant entries into OwnerFormField values after import?
Does the data provider mint the `OwnerFormField` values contained in the constant, or does the owner interface mint them by converting untyped constant rows into the model?

quotes:
The typed constants of the data closure, the one home of each value the
generated code reads that is neither a setting of the environment
(`runtime_settings`) nor a member of an enumeration or a field's type
(`models`) (SPEC_STANDARD
§6.10, §15.3.1; reopened 2026-11-11, replacing the former
release_declarations module):

`models`, for exactly the row models and enumerations of its eight tables:
`ArtifactTypeOwner` (a type with its owner service) and `ServiceName` for
`ARTIFACT_TYPE_OWNERS`; `ServiceRight` (a service and an operation) with
`ServiceName` and `ServiceOperation` for `SERVICE_RIGHTS`;
`ServiceHighestClass` (a service and its highest class) with `ServiceName`
and `DisclosureClass` for `SERVICE_HIGHEST_CLASSES`; `PersonalDataField` (an
answer model's name and a field's) for `PERSONAL_DATA_FIELDS`;
`RefusalHttpStatus` (a code and its status) with `RefusalCode` for
`REFUSAL_HTTP_STATUSES`; `OwnerActionRoute` (an owner action, its method and
path, whether it is a change and whether it touches an uploaded file) with
`OwnerAction` for `OWNER_ACTIONS`; `OwnerAuditAction` (an owner action,
a customer mark's transition or a project erasure's kind where the action
has one, and the audit action it writes) with `OwnerAction`,
`CustomerTransition`, `ProjectErasure` and `AuditAction` for
`OWNER_AUDIT_ACTIONS`; `OwnerFormField` (an owner form field's name, the
model it fills and how its text is read) with `OwnerFormCarrier` and
`FormValueKind` for `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`. Its other constants are scalars and import nothing.
judgement.why: State 3 makes OWNER_FORM_FIELDS a typed constant owned by data_provider and makes data_provider depend on the OwnerFormField row model, so the provider constructs and exports OwnerFormField values rather than raw or uninstantiated structural records.

topics.topic: Complete OwnerFormField field schema and ordinary-model declaration
questions: The passage must become an explicit declaration of every `OwnerFormField` field and its type.
The passage must become a closed ordinary-model declaration containing a `fields` object, rather than merely asserting that a row shape is declared.

What facts does one OwnerFormField contain: are path and values separate facts, alternatives, or one combined fact; what does “its values” denote; and is the tuple-position mark part of the path or a separate fact?
Replace the assertion that `models` declares the row's shape with a complete declaration of every OwnerFormField field and its type.

quotes:
Facts: the field's name, which holds its path and the mark of each tuple
position in it, so that two rows of different paths are different rows; what
it fills; how its text is read. No two rows share a name: the name alone
picks a row, and a table in which two rows share one is not a release.

The release: the data provider's `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` constant, which the
owner interface imports and `models` never does; `models` declares only the
row's shape.
judgement.why: The text names the row's facts and asserts that models declares its shape but never specifies the type of each field as §5 requires.

Which owner-interface product actions read `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`, and is there one shared reader or a separate consumer for each applicable form or query?

judgement.why: P5 already judged the same question about which owner pages, actions, forms, and queries use OWNER_FORM_FIELDS, and the relevant passages have not changed.

precedent.topic: Scope and applicability of OwnerFormField rows across owner pages, actions, forms, and query parameters
quotes:
Which action a request names, by its
method and path, and whether it is a change or touches an uploaded file, are
the rows of the data provider's `OWNER_ACTIONS`; its target is the query
parameter `OWNER_TARGET_PARAMETER` names, its CSRF value the form field
`OWNER_CSRF_FIELD` names, every other field it reads or a page writes a row
of `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` (owner, 2026-11-25), the session cookie's name
`OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` and its attributes
`OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES`, and a page's HTTP status the service API's
`SERVICE_ANSWER_STATUS` and `REFUSAL_HTTP_STATUSES` (owner, 2026-11-24).

Every other field is a row of the
data provider's `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` (`OwnerFormField`). A row's `name` is
the field's name: its path in the `OwnerRequest` or `OwnerValues` it fills
(`carrier`), parts joined by a full stop, with a tuple's position written
where the row holds `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK` (`#`), as decimal digits
from 0.
precedent.why: The later texts make OWNER_FORM_FIELDS global to every non-target, non-CSRF owner-interface field that a page writes or a request reads, with rows selected by carrier and destination path rather than by a page or action fact.

topics.topic: Concrete data-provider module that owns and exports OWNER_FORM_FIELDS
questions: Which concrete data-provider module or component owns and exports `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`?
Which release controls the lifecycle of these values: the Registry product release, a separately versioned data-provider release, or another release boundary?

quotes:
A test release is this release whose `data_provider`
is emitted from `70_data_provider_closure.json` with other values for
named constants. Every other module is the same code. A module reads a
constant only by importing it by name from `data_provider` (Constants
each module imports, State 5). A process therefore runs with the values of
the `data_provider` it imported, and a test release takes effect at the
start of a new process (owner, 2026-11-24).
judgement.why: State 6 defines data_provider as part of the Registry release and says that release's imported constant values take effect when a new process starts, excluding an independently changing provider package boundary.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
